specification.title: A source filter with no match signals an explicit gap
specification.description: A source filter that matches no persisted source produces an explicit retrieval gap.
specification.purpose: Verify a source filter matching no persisted source yields an explicit retrieval gap instead of fabricated results.
specification.operational_relevance: Honest gap signaling prevents downstream synthesis from building claims on missing corpora.
specification.regression_risk: The retriever could silently return unrelated documents to mask the gap.

required: The retrieval returns no material for the unmatched source filter
The retrieval declares the explicit gap
forbidden: The retrieval fabricates results when no source matches
